intended_object: The alternatization (antisymmetrization) of a multilinear map f : M^ι → N, Alt(f)(v) = Σ_{σ ∈ Sym(ι)} sign(σ) · f(v ∘ σ). This is an alternating map, and the operation is additive in f. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation:
The body defines the map f ↦ Σ_σ sign(σ) • f.domDomCongr σ, and `domDomCongr σ f` is v ↦ f(v ∘ σ). This is the standard alternatization without the 1/n! factor, the usual convention when working over a general ring. Proving that the result is alternating is handled by an auxiliary lemma. Additivity in f, so that the result is an AddMonoidHom, holds as stated.

The setting is natural. The codomain N' must be an additive group so that the sign can act by ±1, and R only needs to be a semiring. The index type ι must be finite for the sum over permutations to make sense, and decidable equality is needed to work with permutations. These are exactly the hypotheses the construction uses. This is Mathlib's own canonical definition of the notion, so no other Mathlib declaration of it exists.
